title: Every "O My Dear Father" in the Quran Is Spoken by a Child Who Turned Out Right
excerpt: The vocative yā abati occurs eight times in the Quran, from four speakers — Yusuf, Ibrahim, the daughter of Madyan, Ismail — every one of them upright. And the one son shown withholding the word answers his father's summons with a mountain, and drowns.
seo_title: 'O My Father' (Ya Abati) in the Quran: A Vocative Pattern
seo_description: The Quranic vocative ya abati is spoken only by righteous children — Yusuf, Ibrahim, Ismail, the daughter of Madyan — while Nuh's drowning son withholds it. A close reading of address and adab.
